global_rules.market: effective-dated security metadata or market-level domain identity

storage_contract.description: Per-column source coverage of every observed *_versions table, aligned with docs/source_field_audit.md. ROADMAP PR #14.

coverage_terms.sourced: an inspected official endpoint publishes the value for the whole v1 window and both markets
coverage_terms.partially_sourced: published for only some dates, markets, or securities; audit section 5 lists every one
coverage_terms.unsourced: no inspected source publishes it; the column stays NULL and no v1 PR may promise it
coverage_terms.internal: identity, interval boundary, or provenance linkage that is not expected to come from a source field

storage_contract.source_fields_note: Exact published column labels where the audit records them; where the audit certifies a whole table instead (4.3, 4.4, 4.5), the endpoint is named.

excluded_tables.derived_metric_versions: Canonical derived data, not an observed source domain. Its contract is the derived dataset definition registry, not a source field mapping.

corporate_action_versions.reason: Exchange result feeds TWT49U, TWTAUU, TWTB8U, TPEx exDailyQ and revivt, plus the TWSE Detail endpoints (audit 4.10).

event_id.note: Stable event identity (security, source, source event key). TWSE's 詳細資料 locator "{code},{yyyymmdd}" exists only in response=json.

action_type.note: Derived from the feed that published the row and its own event marker, not invented.

capital_reduction_kind.note: TWTAUU and revivt publish the reduction reason.

announcement_date.note: No exchange result feed carries an announcement date. The issuer declaration feeds that do carry board-resolution dates have no link to an executed event (PR #33, audit 4.13).

ex_date.note: Ex-right/ex-dividend date, or the resumption date for capital reduction and par-value change.

record_date.note: No exchange result feed carries a record date.

payment_date.note: No exchange result feed carries a payment date.

cash_dividend_per_share.note: TWT49UDetail for TWSE, exDailyQ for TPEx.

capital_reduction_cash_return_per_share.note: TWTAVUDetail and the revivt inline detail.

earnings_stock_ratio.note: The exchange feeds publish only the combined free-share figure. The earnings / capital-surplus split exists only in the MOPS issuer declaration feed, stored as its own domain by PR #33 (audit 4.13).

capital_surplus_stock_ratio.note: The exchange feeds publish only the combined free-share figure. The split exists only in the MOPS issuer declaration feed (PR #33), and before ROC 110 the two reserves arrive as one number (audit 4.13).

old_shares.note: Capital reduction only: the old side is the constant 1,000 of 每壹仟股. TWTB8U par-value-change detail fields are not yet verified and no TPEx par-value endpoint was found.

new_shares.note: Capital reduction only. TWTB8U par-value-change detail fields are not yet verified and no TPEx par-value endpoint was found.
